caption: The drawing features a set of intricate black-on-beige ornamental designs arranged in a formal composition. At the top is a horizontal decorative border with a repeating floral and scroll pattern. Below this are five vertically-aligned shield-like shapes: the two outermost contain swirling foliage motifs, the two adjacent to the center contain flower clusters, and the central shield contains a decorative border with the letters "W.B.B." in script inside it. Above these shield-like shapes is an undulating row of stylized acanthus leaves. Below them are two straight horizontal lines, each filled with a continuous, symmetrical pattern of ornamental scrollwork and floral elements, similar in style to the upper border. The drawing is executed in fine lines and stippling, all in monochrome, on a plain light background. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten note: “full size T. Ward.”
title: Silver Christening Bowl
